capabilities: Sync Markdown-table flashcards to Anki as Basic cards
Assign decks and subdecks via #anki/... tags and rename them on resync
Delete Anki cards by removing their table rows or unsyncing a file
Embed images and Excalidraw drawings on card faces
Add backlink URLs from Anki cards to the source note row
extras: Supports only Basic cards and a single minimal Markdown-table format; deleting the Anki-ID line manually is warned against.
motivation: The author wanted to spend 'zero time tweaking settings and 100 % of your time learning', so built a minimal, single-command sync.
problem: Existing Obsidian-to-Anki workflows require configuration, background daemons, or special syntax, which interrupts study time.

relations.evidence: Anki must be running with the AnkiConnect extension installed and active
Embed .excalidraw drawings seamlessly. They are automatically converted to images on sync

summary: Flashcard sync plugin that pushes Markdown-table flashcards from notes to Anki as Basic cards via AnkiConnect, with one command and no settings.
